20201-mary-gray.title: Mary Gray
20201-mary-gray.creator: Unknown
20201-mary-gray.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The house where Mary Gray was born and grew towards womanhood was one of a squat line of mean little houses that hid themselves behind a great church. The roadway in front of the houses led only to the back entrance of the church.

arxiv-2012-00602.title: On Stretch-Limited Elastic Strings
arxiv-2012-00602.creator: Casey Rodriguez
arxiv-2012-00602.description: Abstract . Motivated by the increased interest in modeling nondissipative materials by constitutive relations more general than those from Cauchy elasticity, we initiate the study of a class of stretch-limited elastic strings : the string cannot be compressed smaller than a certain length less than its natural length nor elongated larger than a certain length greater than its natural length.

arxiv-2112-09561.title: Exactly solvable model of a passive Brownian heat engine and its comparison with active engines.
arxiv-2112-09561.creator: Rita Majumdar, Arnab Saha, Rahul Marathe
arxiv-2112-09561.description: Abstract We perform an extensive analysis of passive as well as active micro-heat engines with different single-particle stochastic models. Using stochastic thermodynamics we calculate thermodynamic work, heat, entropy production and efficiency of passive and active Brownian heat engines analytically as well as numerically and compare them.

arxiv-2301-09862.title: Same or Different? Diff-Vectors for Authorship Analysis
arxiv-2301-09862.creator: Silvia Corbara, Alejandro Moreo, Fabrizio Sebastiani
arxiv-2301-09862.description: Abstract . In this paper we investigate the effects on authorship identification tasks (including authorship verification, closed-set authorship attribution, and closed-set and open-set same-author verification) of a fundamental shift in how to conceive the vectorial representations of documents that are given as input to a supervised learner.

arxiv-2305-15610.title: SPARSE-R: A point-cloud tracer with random forcing
arxiv-2305-15610.creator: Daniel Domínguez-Vázquez, Gustaaf B. Jacobs
arxiv-2305-15610.description: Abstract A predictive, point-cloud tracer is presented that determines with a quantified uncertainty the Lagrangian motion of a group of point-particles within a finite region. The tracer assumes a random forcing within confidence intervals to account for the empiricism of data-driven force models and stochasticity related to the chaotic nature of the subcloud scale dynamics.

arxiv-2306-04585.title: RTAEval : A framework for evaluating runtime assurance logic
arxiv-2306-04585.creator: Kristina Miller, Christopher K. Zeitler, William Shen, Mahesh Viswanathan, Sayan Mitra
arxiv-2306-04585.description: Abstract Runtime assurance (RTA) addresses the problem of keeping an autonomous system safe while using an untrusted (or experimental) controller. This can be done via logic that explicitly switches between the untrusted controller and a safety controller, or logic that filters the input provided by the untrusted controller.

arxiv-2310-19173.title: Can we Quantify Trust? Towards a Trust-based Resilient SIoT Network
arxiv-2310-19173.creator: Subhash Sagar, Adnan Mahmood, Quan Z. Sheng, Munazza Zaib, Farhan Sufyan
arxiv-2310-19173.description: Abstract The emerging yet promising paradigm of the Social Internet of Things (SIoT) integrates the notion of the Internet of Things with human social networks. In SIoT, objects, i.e., things , have the capability to socialize with the other objects in the SIoT network and can establish their social network autonomously by modeling human behaviour.

arxiv-2402-08652.title: Dark matter as the trigger of flavor changing neutral current decays of the top quark Preprint: CTPU-PTC-23-35, CERN-TH-2023-235, OU-HET-1217
arxiv-2402-08652.creator: Adil Jueid, and Shinya Kanemura
arxiv-2402-08652.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Adil Jueid, and Shinya Kanemura. We suggest a simplified model that simultaneously addresses the dark-matter problem and give rise to top quark flavor changing neutral current (FCNC) interactions at the one-loop order. The model consists of two extra S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) L SU(2)_{L} gauge singlets: a colored mediator of spin zero ( S S ) and a right-handed fermion ( χ \chi ) both are odd under an ad-hoc Z 2 Z_{2} symmetry.

arxiv-2412-16142.title: The Classical Super-Rotation Infrared Triangle Classical Logarithmic Soft Theorem as Conservation Law in Gravity
arxiv-2412-16142.creator: Sangmin Choi, Alok Laddha, Andrea Puhm
arxiv-2412-16142.description: Abstract The universality of gravitational scattering at low energies and large distances encoded in soft theorems and memory effects can be understood from symmetries. In four-dimensional asymptotically flat spacetimes the infinite enhancement of translations, extending the Poincaré group to the BMS group, is the symmetry underlying Weinberg’s soft graviton theorem and the gravitational displacement memory effect.

arxiv-2504-05986.title: Nehari’s Theorem and Hardy’s inequality for Paley–Wiener spaces
arxiv-2504-05986.creator: Konstantinos Bampouras
arxiv-2504-05986.description: Abstract . Recently it was proven that for a convex subset of ℝ n \mathbb{R}^{n} that has infinitely many extreme vectors, the Nehari theorem fails, that is, there exists a bounded Hankel operator H ϕ \Ha_{\phi} on the Paley–Wiener space PW ⁡ ( Ω ) \PW(\Omega) that does not admit a bounded symbol.

arxiv-2506-07731.title: NeurIPS 2025 E2LM Competition : Early Training Evaluation of Language Models Thanks: California Institute of Technology, Pasadena, CA, USA
arxiv-2506-07731.creator: Mouadh Yagoubi, Yasser Dahou, Billel Mokeddem, Younes Belkada, Basma El Amel Boussaha, Reda Alami, Jingwei Zuo, Mugariya Farooq, Mounia Lalmas, Patrick Gallinari, Philip Torr, Hakim Hacid
arxiv-2506-07731.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Mouadh Yagoubi, Yasser Dahou, Billel Mokeddem, Younes Belkada, Basma El Amel Boussaha, Reda Alami, Jingwei Zuo, Mugariya Farooq, Mounia Lalmas, Patrick Gallinari, Philip Torr, Hakim Hacid. Existing benchmarks have proven effective for assessing the performance of fully trained large language models. However, we find striking differences in the early training stages of small models, where benchmarks often fail to provide meaningful or discriminative signals.

arxiv-2508-14175.title: Ground calibration plans for the AXIS high speed camera
arxiv-2508-14175.creator: Catherine E. Grant, Eric D. Miller, Marshall W. Bautz, Jill Juneau, Beverly J. LaMarr, Andrew Malonis, Gregory Y. Prigozhin, Christopher W. Leitz, Steven W. Allen, Tanmoy Chattopadhyay, Sven Herrmann, R. Glenn Morris, Abigail Y. Pan, Artem Poliszczuk, Haley R. Stueber, Daniel R. Wilkins

Prigozhin, Christopher W. Leitz, Steven W. Allen, Tanmoy Chattopadhyay, Sven Herrmann, R. Glenn Morris, Abigail Y. Pan, Artem Poliszczuk, Haley R. Stueber, Daniel R. Wilkins. The Advanced X-ray Imaging Satellite (AXIS), an astrophysics NASA probe mission currently in phase A, will provide high-throughput, high-spatial resolution X-ray imaging in the 0.3 to 10 keV band.

arxiv-2509-06560.title: Universal quantum control over bosonic network
arxiv-2509-06560.creator: Zhu-yao Jin, Jun Jing
arxiv-2509-06560.description: Abstract Perfect transfer of unknown states across distinct nodes is fundamental in the construction of bosonic quantum networks. We here develop a general theory to control an N N -node bosonic network governed by the time-dependent Hamiltonian, as the universal quantum control theory for continuous-variable systems.

arxiv-2512-08038.title: SSplain: Sparse and Smooth Explainer for Retinopathy of Prematurity Classification
arxiv-2512-08038.creator: Elifnur Sunger, Tales Imbiriba, Peter Campbell, Deniz Erdogmus, Stratis Ioannidis, Jennifer Dy
arxiv-2512-08038.description: Abstract Neural networks are frequently used in medical diagnosis. However, due to their black-box nature, model explainers are used to help clinicians understand better and trust model outputs. This paper introduces an explainer method for classifying Retinopathy of Prematurity (ROP) from fundus images. Previous methods fail to generate explanations that preserve input image structures such as smoothness and sparsity.

arxiv-2601-14652.title: Mas- Orchestra: Understanding and Improving Multi-Agent Reasoning Through Holistic Orchestration and Controlled Benchmarks
arxiv-2601-14652.creator: Zixuan Ke, Yifei Ming, Austin Xu, Ryan Chin, Xuan-Phi Nguyen, Prathyusha Jwalapuram, Jiayu Wang, Semih Yavuz, Caiming Xiong, Shafiq Joty
arxiv-2601-14652.description: A 2026 arXiv research paper by Zixuan Ke, Yifei Ming, Austin Xu, Ryan Chin, Xuan-Phi Nguyen, Prathyusha Jwalapuram, Jiayu Wang, Semih Yavuz, Caiming Xiong, Shafiq Joty. While multi-agent systems (MAS) promise elevated intelligence through coordination of agents, current approaches to automatic MAS design under-deliver.

arxiv-2602-11577.title: LeafFit: Plant Assets Creation from 3D Gaussian Splatting Volume: 45 Issue: 2
arxiv-2602-11577.creator: Chang Luo and Nobuyuki Umetani The University of Tokyo, Japan
arxiv-2602-11577.description: Abstract We propose LeafFit, a pipeline that converts 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) of individual plants into editable, instanced mesh assets. While 3DGS faithfully captures complex foliage, its high memory footprint and lack of mesh topology make it incompatible with traditional game production workflows.

arxiv-2602-17041.title: Reframing Population-Adjusted Indirect Comparisons as a Transportability Problem: An Estimand-Based Perspective and Implications for Health Technology Assessment Publication type: PREPRINT MANUSCRIPT
arxiv-2602-17041.creator: Conor Chandler, Jack Ishak
arxiv-2602-17041.description: Abstract Population-adjusted indirect comparisons (PAICs) are widely used to synthesize evidence when randomized controlled trials enroll different patient populations and head-to-head comparisons are unavailable. Although PAICs adjust for observed population differences across trials, adjustment alone does not ensure transportability of estimated effects to decision-relevant populations for health technology assessment (HTA).

pmc-11644002.title: In Vitro Antibacterial Activity, Molecular Docking, and ADMET Analysis of Phytochemicals from Roots of Dovyalis abyssinica
pmc-11644002.creator: Dereilo Bekere Belitibo, Asfaw Meressa, Abiy Abebe, Temesgen Negassa, Milkyas Endale, Frehiwot Teka Assamo, Messay Wolde-Mariam, Temesgen Abdisa Ayana, Marcel Frese, Norbert Sewald, Negera Abdissa
pmc-11644002.description: Dovyalis abyssinica is widely used in Ethiopia for treating various human ailments, yet its pharmacological properties and chemical composition remain largely unexplored. The chromatographic separation of D. abyssinica roots extract afforded five compounds, namely tremulacin (1), cochinchiside A (2), 5-methoxydurmillone (3), catechin-7-O-α-L-rhamnopyranoside (4), and stigmasterol (5), confirmed via IR, NMR, and MS spectral data.

pmc-12732201.title: Short-Term Neonatal Outcomes Following Early-Term vs. Full-Term and Late-Preterm Births: Insights from a Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-12732201.creator: Nadav Kadosh, Ron Zeitouni, Roni Shlesinger Schwartz, Smadar Eventov-Friedman, Noa Ofek Shlomai, Stefan Grosek, Dominique Singer
pmc-12732201.description: Highlights What are the main findings? •Early term birth is associated with increased short-term morbidity, and potentially with long-term adverse outcomes.•Birth at early term has been linked to greater weight loss, lower breastfeeding rates, higher respiratory morbidity, and prolonged hospital stays. What are the implications of the main findings?

pmc-13117478.title: Integrating Intestinal Ultrasound in the Personalized Management of IBD
pmc-13117478.creator: Cristina Lanzotti, Mariangela Allocca, Alessandra Zilli, Ferdinando D’Amico, Virginia Solitano, Sara Massironi, Silvio Danese, Federica Furfaro
pmc-13117478.description: Personalized medicine is increasingly shaping the management of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), with the goal of tailoring diagnostic and therapeutic strategies to individual patients. Intestinal ultrasound (IUS) has emerged as a pivotal, non-invasive, and repeatable tool for assessing disease activity, treatment response, and complications in both Crohn’s disease and ulcerative colitis.

pmc-13391711.title: Simultaneous activation of border-associated immune cells and glial cells at the CNS-meningeal interface after subarachnoid haemorrhage in rats
pmc-13391711.creator: Thannoon Masood, Szandra Lakatos, Melissza Ignácz, Judit Rosta

pmc-13457280.title: Clinical significance of SQSTM1 variants in ALS: report of p.Arg119Cys and literature review
pmc-13457280.creator: Boyang Su, Ling Li, Xiaoxiao Zheng, Hongyue Ma, Xiuli Li, Xinhong Feng
pmc-13457280.description: We analyzed the clinical features of a patient with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) carrying a novel variant in the sequestosome 1 (SQSTM1) gene and explored the genotype-phenotype association of SQSTM1 gene variants in combination with previous literature. Clinical data and genetic testing results of an ALS patient treated at our hospital were collected.

pmc-13581460.title: pLM-SAV: a Δ-embedding approach for predicting pathogenic single amino acid variants
pmc-13581460.creator: Orsolya Gereben, Hedvig Tordai, Lana Khamisi, Erda Qorri, Tamás Hegedűs
pmc-13581460.description: MotivationPredicting whether single amino acid variants (SAVs) in proteins lead to pathogenic outcomes is a critical challenge in molecular biology and precision medicine. Experimental determination of all possible mutation effects is infeasible, and while state-of-the-art tools such as AlphaMissense show promise, their diagnostic performance is insufficient and they are often difficult to run locally.

pmc-13682907.title: Nationwide Survey of Antimicrobial Stewardship in Korean Hospitals: Insights From the Early Stage of the 2024 National Pilot Implementation
pmc-13682907.creator: Sung Min Lim, Raeseok Lee, Se Yoon Park, Jinnam Kim, Ji Young Park, Choseok Yoon, Song Mi Moon, Yong Chan Kim, Hong Bin Kim, Myung Jin Lee, Bongyoung Kim
pmc-13682907.description: BackgroundAntimicrobial stewardship programmes (ASPs) are essential for optimising antibiotic use and mitigating antimicrobial resistance. In Korea, antimicrobial consumption exceeds the Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development average, and ASP activities remain fragmented, particularly in smaller hospitals. In November 2024, the National Health Insurance Service introduced a pilot reimbursement scheme to support ASPs in hospitals with ≥ 300 beds.

uslaw-usc-t7-s241.title: 7 U.S.C. § 241 — Definitions
uslaw-usc-t7-s241.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t7-s241.description: United States Code, Title 7 (Agriculture); Chapter 10 (Warehouses). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. In this chapter: (1) Agricultural product The term “agricultural product” means an agricultural commodity, as determined by the Secretary, including a processed product of an agricultural commodity. (2) Approval The term “approval” means the consent provided by the Secretary for a person to engage in an activity authorized.
